title: The Wicked + The Divine — Why You Feel It, And Who Decided #Shorts
description:
Modern psychology keeps rediscovering what the pessimists said first about The Wicked + The Divine. The Wicked + The Divine is a contemporary fantasy comic book series created by Kieron Gillen and Jamie McKelvie, and published by Image Comics. The series is largely influenced by pop music and various mythological deities, and includes the themes of life and death in the story.

Meaning is not found in The Wicked + The Divine — it is manufactured for it. With no heads sacrificed in the 2010s Recurrence, and both the Ananke and the Minerva having been killed, the cycle is finally free from her corruption and cannot be repeated by anyone else. Laura and her surviving peers go on to commit to a lifetime of work, using their powers without godhood to better the world.
